topicName: What are the advantages of using JPA over JDBC?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What are the advantages of using JPA over JDBC?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"JPA (Java Persistence API) simplifies database interactions in Java applications by providing an abstraction layer over JDBC. It reduces boilerplate code, improves maintainability, and offers object-relational mapping (ORM) capabilities."}]
